title: DATA ANALYSIS USING MICROSOFT EXCEL
description: Covers Microsoft Excel software skills necessary for evidence-based problem-solving, including workbook editing, formula creation, charting, and pivot tables. Emphasizes hands-on learning, using Excel functions to perform data analysis to enhance decision-making.
registration_restrictions:

  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
